query:
SELECT 'inspection_charges' as tabela, COUNT(*) as restantes FROM inspection_charges 
WHERE LOWER(client_email) LIKE '%test%' OR LOWER(vessel_name) LIKE '%test%'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'fuel_records', COUNT(*) FROM fuel_records 
WHERE LOWER(vessel_name) LIKE '%test%' OR LOWER(client_email) LIKE '%test%'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'inspections', COUNT(*) FROM inspections 
WHERE LOWER(vessel_name) LIKE '%test%' OR LOWER(client_email) LIKE '%test%' OR LOWER(client_name) LIKE '%test%'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'reviews', COUNT(*) FROM reviews 
WHERE LOWER(client_email) LIKE '%test%' OR LOWER(client_name) LIKE '%test%'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'maintenances', COUNT(*) FROM maintenances 
WHERE LOWER(vessel_name) LIKE '%test%' OR LOWER(description) LIKE '%test%'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'asaas_customers', COUNT(*) FROM asaas_customers 
WHERE LOWER(client_email) LIKE '%test%' OR LOWER(name) LIKE '%test%'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'bookings', COUNT(*) FROM bookings 
WHERE LOWER(vessel_name) LIKE '%test%' OR LOWER(client_name) LIKE '%test%' OR LOWER(client_email) LIKE '%test%'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'allowed_clients', COUNT(*) FROM allowed_clients 
WHERE LOWER(name) LIKE '%test%' OR LOWER(email) LIKE '%test%'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'employees', COUNT(*) FROM employees 
WHERE LOWER(name) LIKE '%test%'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'users', COUNT(*) FROM users 
WHERE LOWER(name) LIKE '%test%' OR LOWER(email) LIKE '%test%';
